dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: I must find a way to resolve these structural issues, post-haste...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What issues?

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: I'm designing a high-speed aquabus, but there's just one problem...

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: After a period of high-speed operation, its internal components begin to vibrate intensely, damaging them...

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: I've tried switching materials many times, but the problem remains. Is the problem with my design, then, or the materials?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I see that aquabus?

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Eh? Well, the trial versions are all in my lab. I came out here to...

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: To... Uh... find... materials...

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: The God King even... assigned me a guard to... to... conduct research under his glorious banner... such happiness...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: See you. Farewell... outlander...

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Speaking of cannonballs, the bigger the better, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What would you need such a large cannonball for?

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Well, for people to sit in, of course, and soar into the skies via the giant cannon's propulsion!

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: My design would have the cannonball be internally hollow, such that two... or even three people could sit inside.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: We'd need thick cushioning as well, so that we don't injure ourselves slamming into the walls of the projectile when it's fired.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Of course, we'll also need adequate food, water, and a Kamera...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, wait! What will such a huge cannonball be made of?

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Hmmm, well, this is exactly the problem I meant to solve.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: I've prepared several experimental material types, and I plan to use each to make a projectile, each with small animals as... passengers.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: *sigh* Speaking of which, I must thank that gentleman for his "high-speed aquabus" idea. It's given me tons of inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: It's not exactly the same sort of "speed" as the cannonball's, of course, but there are still design ideas here that I can gainfully refer to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: Farewell! I wonder what material I should use to make this cannonball.

dialogues.speaker: Babisse
dialogues.text: You have to... We have to look up at the sky and cease obsessing over Mora and tall towers. An empty space is where a researcher truly belongs...
